Eligibility & Enrollment Who Can Join: The Program is open to current students, alumni, educational influencers, and external marketers. Exclusions: Parents/Guardians: Parents cannot refer their own children or direct dependents. This program is strictly for external referrals and cannot be used as a method to obtain a “discount” on your own family’s fees. Staff: SJ Academy administration and finance staff are ineligible to participate. Registration: You must register via the official form to generate your unique “Referral Code” (e.g., SJ-ALI-001). Referrals made without a valid code are not eligible for commission. 2. Definition of a “Qualified Referral” To earn a commission, the referred student must meet ALL of the following criteria: New Student Status: The student must be new to SJ Academy. Students who have studied at SJ Academy at any point in the past 12 months are considered “Returning Students” and do not qualify. Code Usage: The Referral Code must be presented by the student at the time of enrollment . Retroactive claims (e.g., trying to claim a student weeks after they have joined) will not be accepted. No Prior Contact: You cannot claim credit for a student who is already in our database, has previously visited the campus, or has already booked a demo class prior to your referral. 3. Commission Calculation & Bonuses O Level Commission: 10% of the Net Monthly Tuition Fee paid by the student. A Level Commission: 8% of the Net Monthly Tuition Fee paid by the student. Net Fee Rule: Commissions are calculated on the actual amount paid. If a student receives a scholarship or financial aid (e.g., 20% off), your commission is calculated on the discounted fee, not the full list price. Milestone Bonus: A cash bonus of Rs. 5,000 is awarded for every block of 5 successful, active referrals. Recurring Nature: Commissions are paid monthly as long as the student remains enrolled and pays their tuition fees. 4. Payments & Payout Schedule Payout Date: Commissions are calculated at the end of each calendar month. Payments are processed between the 5th and 10th of the following month. Payment Methods: We prioritize your convenience. Payouts can be made via: Bank Transfer JazzCash / EasyPaisa Cash Collection (at the Academy counter, with prior notice) Minimum Threshold: A minimum balance of Rs. 1,000 is required for a payout. Balances below this amount will roll over to the next month. 5. Clawback & Refund Policy 30-Day Retention Rule: If a referred student drops out or requests a full fee refund within their first 30 days , the referral is considered “Void” and no commission is earned. Clawback: If a commission was already paid for a student who subsequently receives a fee refund (e.g., due to dissatisfaction in the first month), SJ Academy reserves the right to deduct that amount from your future earnings. 6. Code of Conduct Referrers must act ethically. You may not : Spam SJ Academy’s official social media pages, Google Reviews, or WhatsApp groups with your code. Make false promises (e.g., “Guaranteed A*”) to secure sign-ups. Run paid search ads (Google Ads) bidding on the brand keywords “SJ Academy.” 7. Program Changes SJ Academy reserves the right to modify commission rates, payment terms, or terminate the Program at any time. Active referrals will continue to generate commissions for a grace period of 30 days following any program termination. Our expert O Level Physics tuition builds concepts, confidence, and exam technique so students stop guessing and start scoring. Many students understand Physics in class, then freeze in the exam. They know the chapter, but they cannot solve structured questions under time pressure. At SJ Academy, we fix that. Our physics tuition combines concept clarity, guided problem-solving, and intensive past paper training so your child learns how Cambridge awards marks and how to earn them consistently. 📅 Book Free Demo Class 💬 Chat With Us 2,000+ O Level Students 94% A*-B Rate 15+ Years Experience 4.9/5 Parent Rating Why Your Child Might Be Struggling with O Level Physics Physics does not punish effort. It punishes unclear concepts and weak exam application. Here are the most common issues our O Level Physics tuition fixes. 🧠 The Concept Gap Your child might memorize formulas without understanding what they mean. That creates confusion in forces, electricity, and waves. We rebuild the concept first, then show how it turns into marks in Cambridge-style questions. 🧩 Application Breakdown in Exams In O Level Physics, students lose marks because they cannot translate a scenario into the right steps. They choose the wrong equation, miss a unit, or skip method marks. We train structured problem-solving, not just topic coverage. ⚡ The “I Panic in Numericals” Cycle Physics anxiety is real. One bad test leads to fear, then careless mistakes multiply. Our approach builds confidence through guided practice, timed drills, and clear feedback so students stay calm and accurate under pressure. Complete Cambridge Syllabus Coverage Our O Level Physics tuition covers the full Cambridge syllabus with targeted past paper practice for each area. We prepare students for both understanding and exam performance. 🚀 Mechanics & Motion Speed, velocity, acceleration Forces, moments, equilibrium Work, energy, power Pressure and density Circular motion fundamentals 🌡️ Thermal Physics & Waves Kinetic model of matter Thermal properties and heat transfer Wave properties and wave equations Sound and light basics Refraction and simple optics 🔌 Electricity & Magnetism Current, voltage, resistance Series and parallel circuits Electrical power and safety Magnetism and electromagnetism Practical circuit problem-solving 📝 Paper Strategies Units, significant figures, and accuracy Method marks and working structure Common examiner traps and how to avoid them Time management for structured questions Effective revision using past papers Our 3-Step Formula for O Level Physics Success We combine concept clarity with exam execution so your child stops doing Physics in theory and starts scoring in real papers. 1 👓 Concept Clarity First We explain Physics so it makes sense visually and logically. Your child understands what is happening, not just what to memorize. This is the base of high grades in O Level Physics. 2 🧠 Guided Problem Solving We teach students how to break a question into steps, select the right formula, and show working that earns method marks. This is where grades jump fast. 3 ⏱️ Past Papers Under Exam Conditions Timed past paper practice with feedback. We correct approach, fix weak topics, and train speed and accuracy. Students learn patterns and improve consistency. Taught Personally by Sir Salman Junaid O Level Physics Specialist & Co-Founder 15+ Years O Level Experience As co-founder of SJ Academy, Sir Salman Junaid personally oversees our O Level Physics tuition. Cambridge has confirmed that AS Level Mathematics 9709/12 was shared before the exam, cancelled, and replaced with a new paper on 9 June 2026. That decision may fix one paper. It does not fix three years of broken trust and many other leaked paper that students are stressed about! — students & parents have signed Add Your Voice Students and parents deserve transparency, protection, and a permanent fix. What Still Needs Answers All Other Papers Must Be Investigated With Honesty. Admitted by Cambridge Mathematics 9709/12 Cambridge has confirmed this paper was shared before the exam, cancelled it, and scheduled a replacement paper. Reviewed by SJ Academy Mathematics S1 9709/52 SJ Academy reviewed evidence that this paper was circulating before students entered the exam hall. Students later confirmed that the paper matched. Must be checked All Other Reported Papers Every credible report should be investigated honestly. Fake scams exist, but real leaks cannot be dismissed under the same label. We will not publish leaked exam material. This petition is asking for a proper investigation, a public timeline, and honest answers for students and parents. ↓ The Petition What Students And Parents Are Asking For Demand 01 Full Transparency A clear public explanation of what happened, when Cambridge knew, and what action was taken. Demand 02 A Separate Investigation Into 9709/52 Cambridge must investigate the reported S1 leak properly, not ignore it. Demand 03 Official University Letters Affected students need Cambridge letterhead letters for universities, scholarships, and admissions offices. Demand 04 Student-First Remedies A replacement paper should not be the only answer. Students with deadlines, offers, and serious disruption need support. Demand 05 A Pakistan-Specific Security Review After repeated leaks, Cambridge and the British Council must review how papers are handled, protected, and monitored in Pakistan. Demand 06 A Public Timeline Students and parents deserve to know when investigations will end and when decisions will be announced. Important This Petition Does Not Defend Cheating. For honest students For worried parents For a fair exam system Students who bought, shared, or used leaked papers should face consequences. This petition is for honest students. The students who prepared properly. The students who walked into the exam hall in good faith. The students now carrying the stress of a failure they did not create. We are not asking Cambridge to ignore malpractice. We are asking Cambridge to protect innocent students and fix the system that allowed this to happen. Sign It. Share It. Make It Impossible To Ignore. Every signature adds pressure for a serious response. Purpose of This Policy This Fee & Payment Policy explains how tuition fees, monthly payments, late payments, recordings, withdrawals, and final-month dues are handled at SJ Academy. By registering with SJ Academy, the student and/or parent/guardian agrees to follow this policy fully. This policy is designed to ensure clear communication, uninterrupted academic support, and fair financial discipline throughout the academic session. 2. Monthly Fee Payment All monthly tuition fees must be paid on or before the 10th of each month . Fee payment is the responsibility of the student and/or parent/guardian. SJ Academy may send reminders as a courtesy, but non-receipt of a reminder does not remove the responsibility to pay fees on time. If the fee is not paid by the due date, SJ Academy reserves the right to: Apply late payment charges Temporarily pause access to classes Temporarily pause access to recordings, notes, tests, or academic resources Withhold further academic support until dues are cleared Refuse continuation of enrollment in cases of repeated delay 3. Advance Fee for Final Exam Months To protect the continuity of classes and prevent last-month payment defaults, students appearing in external examination sessions must pay the final two months together. Oct/Nov Examination Session Students appearing in the Oct/Nov CAIE examination session must pay the September and October fees together . This combined payment must be made before the start of September classes or by the payment deadline communicated by SJ Academy. May/June Examination Session Students appearing in the May/June CAIE examination session must pay the April and May fees together . This combined payment must be made before the start of April classes or by the payment deadline communicated by SJ Academy. This rule applies because the final months of preparation are academically critical. Teachers continue giving revision support, past paper practice, marking guidance, mocks, and exam-focused support during this period. Students cannot attend or access these services without clearing the required final-month fees. 4. Late Payment Charges Monthly fee must be paid before the 10th of each month. If payment is delayed, SJ Academy may apply late payment charges. The amount, timing, and method of applying late charges will be communicated by SJ Academy. Repeated late payments may result in stricter payment conditions, including advance payment requirements or temporary suspension of services. 5. Full-Month Fee Policy Students joining at any time during a month must pay the full fee for that month . SJ Academy does not offer partial-month billing because students are provided access to the academic support and recordings for the complete month, where applicable. This means that even if a student joins in the middle or toward the end of a month, the full monthly fee will still apply. 6. Access to Previous Recordings Students who want access to recordings from previous months must pay a one-time recording access fee of PKR 8,000 . This payment provides access to selected previous-month recordings relevant to the student’s enrolled subject or course, subject to availability. Recording access is provided for academic use only. Students are not allowed to download, share, forward, reproduce, screen-record, resell, or distribute SJ Academy recordings or learning material in any form. Violation of this rule may result in immediate cancellation of access without refund. 7. Payment Confirmation After making an online transfer, the student or parent/guardian must immediately share the screenshot or proof of payment on the following WhatsApp number: +92 336 2144454 The screenshot should clearly show: Student name Subject or course Month being paid for Amount paid Transaction reference, where available SJ Academy will only treat the payment as submitted once proof of payment has been received and verified. 8. Non-Payment and Suspension of Services If dues remain unpaid after the due date, SJ Academy reserves the right to suspend the student’s access to: Physical classes Online classes Class recordings WhatsApp groups Notes and worksheets Tests and mocks Teacher feedback Marking support Revision sessions Academic consultation Suspension due to non-payment does not cancel the outstanding dues. The student or parent/guardian will still be required to clear all pending amounts before access can be restored. 9. No Refund Policy Fees paid to SJ Academy are generally non-refundable and non-transferable . No refund will be provided for: Missed classes Student absence Change of mind after registration Partial-month attendance Discontinuation without notice Failure to attend online or physical classes Failure to use recordings or academic resources Suspension caused by non-payment or policy violation SJ Academy may review exceptional cases at its sole discretion, but approval of any refund, adjustment, or transfer is not guaranteed. 10. Missed Classes and Attendance Students are expected to attend classes regularly. If a student misses a class due to personal reasons, travel, school workload, illness, technical issues, or any other reason outside SJ Academy’s control, the monthly fee remains payable in full. Where recordings are available, SJ Academy may provide access to help the student catch up. However, missed classes do not reduce the fee and cannot be carried forward to the next month. 11. Withdrawal or Discontinuation Students who wish to discontinue classes must inform SJ Academy in writing through WhatsApp or another official communication channel. Withdrawal must be communicated before the start of the next billing month. If a student attends classes, remains part of the class group, accesses recordings, or continues receiving academic support during a month, the full fee for that month will be payable. For examination months, the advance fee rules stated in Section 3 will apply. 12. Final-Month Payment Protection SJ Academy invests significant teacher time, academic planning, revision structure, and examination support during the final stage of preparation. To avoid students discontinuing, delaying payment, or becoming unreachable during the last month before exams, SJ Academy requires advance payment for the final two months of the relevant exam session. A student will not be allowed to continue final-month classes, revision sessions, mocks, marking support, or access recordings unless the required final-month dues are cleared. 13. Fee Adjustments and Changes SJ Academy reserves the right to revise its fee structure, payment schedule, late payment charges, recording access charges, or related financial terms. Any major fee revision will be communicated before implementation. Existing students will be informed through official communication channels. 14. Official Communication All payment-related communication should be made through SJ Academy’s official WhatsApp number: +92 336 2144454 Students and parents are responsible for ensuring that payment screenshots, queries, withdrawal requests, and fee-related messages are shared through the correct channel. 15. Agreement by Student and Parent/Guardian By registering with SJ Academy, the student and/or parent/guardian confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to this Fee & Payment Policy. They agree that: Monthly fees must be paid before the 10th of each month. Late payment charges may apply after the due date. Students joining mid-month must pay the full monthly fee. Previous recordings require a one-time payment of PKR 8,000. Final two-month fees must be paid together before the relevant exam session. Services may be paused if dues are unpaid. Fees are generally non-refundable and non-transferable. Proof of payment must be shared immediately after online transfer. text: AI Workshop - Learn AI & Advance your career! AI Made Simple ★★★★★ 2 days · Rs. 7,500 · 35 seats Overview Who it's for What you'll learn Syllabus Included Instructor FAQs Reserve Artificial Intelligence · Beginner Workshop AI for Beginners | Learn AI & Advance Your Career on 10x Speed A 2-Day Practical Workshop ⭐ Beginner friendly · 2 days · Physical + Online · Rs. 7,500 Learn how to use AI confidently for work, study, business, content, communication, research, and daily productivity, even if you are a complete beginner. SJ Hosted by Sunyyan Junaid Co-founder of SJ Academy, educator, marketer, and practical AI user. Built for professionals, freelancers, business owners, students, teachers, parents, and beginners in Pakistan. Reserve My Seat ● Ask on WhatsApp No coding. No technical background. No confusing AI jargon. Course overview Take your first real step into AI You've probably heard about ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Perplexity, and Canva AI. You may have even tried some of them. But if you still don't know what to ask, which tool to use, or how AI can help with your actual work, study, or business, this workshop is for you. This is a hands-on beginner workshop where you'll learn what AI can do, how to write better prompts, how to avoid common mistakes, and how to use AI for practical daily tasks. You won't become an AI expert in 2 days. But you will stop feeling lost. Who this workshop is for 01 Working professionals who want to use AI for emails, reports, meetings, presentations, research, and communication. 02 Freelancers who want to use AI for client replies, proposals, content ideas, research, and productivity. 03 Small business owners who want help with marketing, captions, customer replies, planning, product descriptions, and daily decisions. 04 Students who want to use AI to understand difficult topics, create study plans, practice questions, and improve learning. 05 Teachers who want to use AI for lesson planning, worksheets, examples, quizzes, and student support. 06 Parents and complete beginners who want to understand AI clearly and use it safely in daily life. Prerequisites ✅ No coding knowledge needed ✅ No technical background needed ✅ You can join even if you have never used ChatGPT properly ✅ Bring a laptop if attending physically, or use your own device if attending online ✅ Free AI tools are enough to start What you'll learn 🤖 What AI is and why it matters Understand what AI can and cannot do, without confusing technical language. 🧰 The main AI tools beginners should know Get a simple overview of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Perplexity, and Canva AI. ✍️ How to write better prompts Learn how to use context, examples, format, tone, and clear instructions to get better results. 💼 AI for work and career Use AI for emails, reports, presentations, meetings, CVs, LinkedIn, interviews, and client communication. 📣 AI for business and content Use AI for social media ideas, captions, marketing plans, customer replies, product descriptions, sales messages, and planning. 📚 AI for learning and personal growth Use AI for studying, explaining difficult topics, creating quizzes, practicing English, building skills, and making learning plans. 🔐 AI safety and common mistakes Understand why AI can be wrong, what not to share, and how to check AI-generated answers. 🗃️ Build your personal AI system Choose your main tools, use cases, saved prompts, and weekly AI habit. Workshop syllabus Day 1: Understand AI and learn how to use it ▾ What AI is and what it can actually do What AI cannot do and why judgement matters The main AI tools beginners should know How to write better prompts Hands-on practice for daily life, planning, writing, and learning Day 2: Use AI for real work and growth ▾ AI for work, emails, reports, meetings, presentations, CVs, and LinkedIn AI for business, marketing, captions, customer replies, and planning AI for learning, quizzes, English practice, and skill-building Free vs paid AI tools AI safety, wrong answers, privacy, and common mistakes Build your personal AI workflow What's included 🎥 4 hours of live training 🧪 Hands-on practice during both days 📍 Physical or online attendance option 📝 Beginner prompt bank 📊 AI tools comparison sheet 🗃️ Personal AI system worksheet 🎓 Certificate of participation 🎁 Post-workshop resource pack 💬 Optional 7-day WhatsApp support after the workshop About the Instructor Sunyyan Junaid Sunyyan Junaid is the Co-founder of SJ Academy, a teacher, marketer, and education entrepreneur. He uses AI in teaching, content, research, planning, marketing, communication, and business workflows. This workshop is designed for beginners, not tech experts. The goal is to make AI simple, practical, and useful for Pakistani work, study, and business contexts. Join the next AI Made Simple workshop Rs. 7,500 per person 📍 Physical at SJ Academy, Karachi + Online via Zoom ⏱️ 2 days · Saturday and Sunday · 2 hours per day 👥 Limited to 35 seats Reserve My Seat Payment details will be shared after registration. Your seat is confirmed after payment. A 2-Day Practical Workshop AI Made Simple Rs. 7,500 per person 📍 Physical at SJ Academy, Karachi 💻 Online via Zoom/Google Meet ⏱️ 2 days , 2 hours per day 👥 Limited to 35 attendees 🎁 Includes prompt bank, comparison sheet, worksheet, resource pack and certificate Reserve My Seat Seat is confirmed after payment. Frequently Asked Questions Is this workshop for complete beginners? + Yes. This workshop is built specifically for people who feel overwhelmed by AI and want a slow, simple, step-by-step introduction. Do I need coding? + Not at all. We will focus purely on using existing AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini in daily life. No coding knowledge is required. What if I have never used ChatGPT properly? + That is completely fine. We start from the absolute basics, including how to write your first useful prompt. Is this only for professionals? + No. It is designed for professionals, freelancers, small business owners, students, teachers, parents, and anyone else who wants to learn. Can students join? + Yes. Students are welcome. You will learn how to use AI as a study partner to understand topics and create learning plans. Can parents or teachers join? + Absolutely. Teachers can use AI for lesson planning, examples, quizzes, and worksheets. Parents can understand how AI is being used and how to guide safer use. Will I need paid AI tools? + No. Free tools are enough to start. We will also explain when paid tools are useful and when they are not necessary. Will I get materials? + Yes. You will receive a beginner prompt bank, a tools comparison sheet, a personal AI system worksheet, and a post-workshop resource pack. Will I get a certificate? + Yes, all participants who complete the 2-day workshop will receive a certificate of participation from SJ Academy. Can I attend online? + Yes. The workshop is hybrid. You can join physically at SJ Academy in Karachi or attend live online via Zoom/Google Meet. How do I pay? + After registering, payment details for direct bank transfer to Sunyyan's account or SJ Academy's account will be shared with you. Will this make me an AI expert? + Honestly, no. You will not become an AI engineer or expert in 4 hours. But you will stop feeling lost, understand how the tools work, and build confidence to use them daily. Every practical is checked by our experienced teachers with corrections and feedback to improve exam performance. 3 Learn How Your CAIE Exam Will Be Marked Master exactly how Cambridge awards marks for: Tables Graphs Significant figures Units Calculations Errors & improvements 4 Trusted by Hundreds of Students Hundreds of A Level students attend SJ Academy practical classes every year, with most achieving A/A* grades in their Cambridge exams. Frequently Asked Questions How long does the practical session last? Our practical session continues until the exam. However, students are prepared completely by mid-September so that all core practical skills are covered well before the exam period. Students are then called back before their exam for final revision, exam technique practice, and expected practical practice if reliable information is available. When is the best time to join? The best time to join is when the session starts. This gives students more time to perform each practical in detail, understand the method properly, correct their mistakes, and build confidence gradually. Students who join later can still cover the practicals, but they may need to attend more regularly to complete everything before the exam. Can I join just before the exam? Yes, students can join close to the exam through our practical workshops, where the key experiments and exam skills are covered in a short time. However, joining earlier is strongly recommended because students get more hands-on practice, more teacher feedback, and more time to improve. The fee remains the same regardless of when a student joins, so it is better to start early. What do I need to bring for the classes? Students should bring basic stationery, a calculator, and a 30 cm ruler. These can also be purchased from the academy if needed. For Chemistry and Biology practicals, students are recommended to keep a lab coat. SJ Academy will provide the practical manual. A Level Physics Practicals at SJ Academy Physics Practicals Chemistry Practicals Biology Practicals At SJ Academy, our A Level Physics practicals are designed to mirror the exact experiments students face in CAIE exams. We focus on building core skills like precise measurements, graph plotting, and analyzing experimental data, all essential for success in Paper 3 and Paper 5. Some of the key experiments we conduct include finding acceleration due to gravity using a free-fall method, verifying Ohm’s Law, investigating spring extension with applied force, and measuring the focal length of a lens. With expert supervision and real lab equipment, students gain confidence and exam readiness through every session. Here’s a list of common A Level Physics practicals we conduct at SJ Academy: Determine the acceleration due to gravity using a free-fall apparatus Verify Ohm’s Law by measuring current and voltage across a resistor Investigate Hooke’s Law by measuring the extension of a spring Determine the resistivity of a wire using a micrometer and voltmeter-ammeter method Find the focal length of a converging lens using the lens formula And a lot more, of course. 🔥 At SJ Academy, our A Level Chemistry practicals are focused on precision, technique, and exam-oriented preparation. We train students to master key lab skills like titration, qualitative analysis, observation recording, and drawing accurate conclusions, all aligned with CAIE Paper 3 and Paper 5 requirements. Common experiments include acid-base titrations to determine unknown concentrations, qualitative analysis of cations and anions, tests for oxidizing and reducing agents, and preparation of standard solutions. Students also carry out organic tests to identify functional groups and reactions. Every session is designed to help students feel fully confident and capable in the lab environment. Here’s a list of the most common A Level Chemistry practicals we conduct at SJ Academy: 1. Oscillations 2. Electricity 3. Mechanical/Equilibrium And a lot more, of course! 🔥 At SJ Academy, our A Level Biology practicals are designed to sharpen observation, analysis, and microscopy skills, exactly what students need to excel in Paper 3 and Paper 5. We guide students through each step of planning, executing, and evaluating experiments, helping them build both accuracy and confidence in the lab. Students perform a wide range of practicals, including microscope slide preparation, enzyme activity experiments, food tests, and fieldwork techniques like quadrat sampling. Each session mirrors real CAIE practicals and helps students understand biological processes through hands-on learning and structured lab reporting. Here’s a list of the most common A Level Biology practicals we conduct at SJ Academy: 1. Food Tests 2. Enzyme tests 3. Sign Me Up → Frequently Asked Questions. Will we be able to prepare completely for the A level practical exams in the workshops ? Yes, you will be covering everything. Along with performing the practicals, you will be explained in detail how the CAIE practical exam is marked. What is the fee for the workshops? Fee is PKR 25000/subject + PKR 3000 Registration fees (one time). Is there any discount if we take all 3 subjects? Yes, you can get a 10% discount if you take all 3 subjects together. What will be the class timings? Class timings for Physics and Chemistry will be between 12 PM to 4 PM. For Biology it will be 4 PM onwards on weekdays and 2 PM on weekends. If you are not able to attend classes at the given times, you can inform us in advance and we will arrange a different time slot for you. I will be doing practicals for the first time. Should I register for the practicals or register earlier? If you do not have any experience with practicals, its better if you register earlier. The total fee will be the same anyways, but you will get time to practice at your own pace initially. But even if you just come for the workshops, we will make sure your preparation is thorough. You might need to spend more time doing the practicals. Do you offer crash courses for last-minute prep? Yes, we offer short crash workshops closer to exam dates to help students revise key experiments, polish their observation skills, and learn quick techniques to avoid common exam mistakes. Are these practicals enough to help me score well in Paper 3? Absolutely. Our sessions are designed not just for hands-on practice but to train you on thinking Physics and Chemistry Practicals . We also give you tips on time management, observation writing, and drawing conclusions just like the marking schemes demand. Can private candidates also register for practicals? Yes! We welcome private candidates from all over Karachi. Whether you’re doing your Physics, Chemistry, or Biology Practicals for the first time or retaking the exam, as an independent student, you’ll get the same expert guidance and lab access. If you’re appearing for your A Level May/June 2026 exams, it’s time to get hands-on experience that sets you apart. At SJ Academy, we prepare students through real lab work, expert mentoring, and complete examiner-style practice, so you walk into your practical exam with total confidence. Register for the Practicals → *LIMITED SEATS Why Join Our 3-Month A Level Practical Crash Course? Our A Level Practical Preparation May/June 2026 in Karachi is structured to help you complete all experiments, master key techniques, and gain full confidence before the exams. By January, you’ll finish all lab work; from February onwards, your focus shifts toward reinforcing theory and polishing exam strategy. Flexible weekend schedule Classes are held only on Saturdays, making it ideal for students managing weekday commitments. Strategic revision support Before your exams, you’ll be invited to exclusive revision sessions to refine techniques, strengthen weak areas, and boost exam readiness. Transparent pricing The fee structure remains consistent whether you join at the start or midway through the 3-month course. A Level Practical Training May/June 2026 in Karachi At SJ Academy, our labs replicate real CAIE exam setups. Every student gains authentic, hands-on exposure to the experiments, materials, and methods used in Cambridge A Level assessments. The course is designed for Paper 3 and Paper 5 mastery, ensuring that students understand not just what to do, but why they do it. Physics Practicals Chemistry Practicals Biology Practicals A Level Physics Practicals May/June 2026 in Karachi At SJ Academy, our A Level Physics Practicals replicate real CAIE experiments. Students master critical lab techniques such as precision measurement, graph plotting, and data analysis, the foundation for success in Paper 3 and Paper 5. Some of the key experiments include: Determining acceleration due to gravity using a free-fall method Verifying Ohm’s Law and Hooke’s Law Measuring resistivity of a wire Finding focal length of a lens Each session is guided by experienced teachers who ensure you understand theory, experiment logic, and data evaluation. Every concept is reinforced with step-by-step demonstrations, making this one of Karachi’s most effective A Level Practical Classes in Karachi May/June 2026 programs. A Level Chemistry Practicals May/June 2026 in Karachi Our A Level Chemistry Practicals focus on precision, accuracy, and technique. Students gain mastery in titrations, qualitative analysis, observation recording, and analytical thinking, all tailored for CAIE success. Key experiments include: Acid-base and redox titration Preparation of standard solutions Qualitative tests for cations, anions, and gases Organic tests for functional groups Separation and purification methods Every class gives you real-lab familiarity. You’ll work with proper apparatus, develop careful observation habits, and learn how to record and conclude your findings exactly as CAIE expects. A Level Biology Practicals May/June 2026 in Karachi The A Level Biology Practicals program sharpens observation and interpretation skills through live experiments designed for Paper 3 and Paper 5 success. Students perform: Microscope and slide preparation Enzyme activity and osmosis experiments Food tests and transpiration studies Fieldwork including quadrat sampling Dissections and photosynthesis experiments Each practical helps you develop precision, patience, and confidence, ensuring full readiness for your A Level Practical Exam May/June 2026 in Karachi . Fee is PKR 25000/subject + PKR 3000 Registration fees (one time). Is there any discount if we take all 3 subjects? Yes, you can get a 10% discount if you take all 3 subjects together. What will be the class timings? Class timings for Physics and Chemistry will be between 12 PM to 4 PM. For Biology it will be 4 PM onwards on weekdays and 2 PM on weekends. Join SJ Academy’s A Level Business Oct/Nov 2026 batch and learn how to write exactly what Cambridge rewards: precise knowledge, case application, chained analysis, and real evaluation. For AS and A2 students who want structured preparation, past paper practice, and answer-writing feedback before exam pressure begins. 📅 Admissions open Oct/Nov 2026 batch starts June 15th, 2026 In-person in Karachi and live online. Seats are limited so students can receive proper checking and feedback. Join the Oct/Nov Batch → WhatsApp Us Why good students still lose marks in Business Most students do not lose marks because they know nothing. They lose marks because their answers do not match what examiners reward. They define instead of applying They know the term, but they do not link it to the business in the question. That weakens application marks. They explain instead of analysing They make a point, but they do not show the full chain of impact from decision to business consequence. They conclude instead of evaluating They write “it depends” but never explain what it depends on using the case or numerical evidence. Complete preparation for all A Level Business papers Every paper needs a different answer style. We train students to know exactly what each mark value requires. Paper 1 Business Concepts 1 Short answers, 8-mark analysis, and 12-mark evaluation with clean structure. Paper 2 Business Concepts 2 Data response, application, calculations, and contextual judgement. Paper 3 Decision-Making Numerical data, recommendations, calculations, and evaluation-heavy 12 markers. Paper 4 Business Strategy 20-mark strategy essays, integrated evaluation, and final contextual judgement. Get batch details on WhatsApp What the Oct/Nov batch includes 01 Syllabus completion by August The batch is planned so students can finish the syllabus early and move into proper past paper practice. 02 Regular tests and assignments Students are tested consistently so weak areas are found before mocks and final revision. 03 All resources and material Students get focused notes, class resources, and answer structures built around Cambridge requirements. 04 Multiple mock exams Mocks help students practise timing, structure, calculations, application, analysis, and evaluation under pressure. 05 Answer checking and feedback Students learn exactly why marks are lost and how to improve the next answer. 06 Live online and physical classes Students can join from Karachi campus or live online without missing interaction and support. How we train you to write better answers A Level Business is not about writing more. It is about writing what Cambridge rewards. 🧭 Paper-by-paper structure You learn the exact answer style for Paper 1, Paper 2, Paper 3, and Paper 4. 📑 Mark scheme practice You practise with Cambridge-style criteria, not vague “good answer” feedback. 🔎 Case application drills You learn how to pull the right data from a case and use it inside your answer. 🔗 Analysis chain training You practise turning one business point into cause, impact, and consequence. ⚖️ Evaluation workshops You learn how to make judgements that are specific, balanced, and contextual. 🎥 Recorded revision support You can revisit lessons, structures, and past paper discussions before mocks and exams. Learn Business from someone who understands both business and the mark scheme. Sir Sunyyan Junaid Sir Sunyyan teaches Business as an exam subject, not as textbook memorisation. Lessons connect real business decisions with Cambridge-style answers, so students learn how to apply concepts, build analysis chains, and write evaluation that earns marks. Cambridge 9609 focused teaching Paper 1, 2, 3, and 4 answer structures Application and evaluation training Past paper practice with marking feedback Real business examples used only when they improve the answer What you will master before Oct/Nov 2026 The goal is simple: stop writing generic answers and start writing exam-ready responses. Every mark type How to answer 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, and 20 mark questions. Case data usage How to use data without copying the case or forcing irrelevant facts. Analysis chains How to build logical chains that examiners can follow clearly. Real evaluation How to move beyond “it depends” and make justified judgements. Paper 3 decisions How to use calculations and numerical evidence in recommendations. Paper 4 strategy How to structure 20-mark strategic answers with evaluation throughout. This batch is for you if... If any of these sound familiar, you do not need more random notes. You need answer-writing training. ✓ You understand the chapters but cannot score high marks. ✓ You write long answers but still get low levels. ✓ You struggle with application and case study use. ✓ Your evaluation sounds generic or repetitive. ✓ You do not know how to structure 12 and 20 mark answers. ✓ You want serious Oct/Nov preparation before past paper pressure begins. Book your seat What parents can expect Parents choose SJ Academy because the focus is not only on covering the syllabus. It is on improving how students write exam answers. Structured weekly classes Students follow a clear Oct/Nov preparation plan instead of random topic coverage. Progress through testing Regular tests and assignments show whether students are improving before the exam gets close. Proper answer feedback Feedback focuses on knowledge, application, analysis, and evaluation, not just whether the answer sounds good. Online students stay involved Live online classes are interactive, organised, and supported with resources and recordings. Exam-focused preparation The aim is to train students to write answers Cambridge rewards across all relevant papers. Limited seats for attention Seats are limited so students can receive checking, feedback, and support during the batch. Students improve when their answers improve. The right teaching makes Business feel less vague and much more manageable. ★★★★★ “As a student studying online from abroad, I can say this academy has been amazing! The overall teaching styles are excellent and the support has been consistent throughout. The classes are highly interactive and well organised! I never feel left out despite being behind a screen. Sir Sunyyan has been a wonderful business teacher and is definitely my favourite tutor ever! He makes complex topics much easier to learn and keeps every business class interesting. I highly recommend SJ Academy! 🌟” - Ghazifa Batool ★★★★★ “The analysis chains taught by Sir Sunyyan helped me jump from a C in my mocks to an A* in the finals.” - Hassan Raza ★★★★★ “His notes are gold. No fluff, just exactly what the examiner wants to see. Everything is exam-focused.” - Ayesha Khan ★★★★★ “The testing system at SJ Academy is rigorous. It forced me to manage my time better for longer evaluation questions.” - Saad Ahmed Questions before you join? Here is what students and parents usually ask before enrolling. Is this for AS or A2? The batch supports A Level Business students based on their route, including AS and A2 paper preparation. Do you cover all papers? Yes. Students are trained for Paper 1, Paper 2, Paper 3, and Paper 4 according to their exam route. Are classes online or in person? Both options are available: in-person classes in Karachi and live online classes. Will past papers be practised? Yes. Past paper practice focuses on mark scheme structure, application, analysis, and evaluation. Will students get feedback? Yes. Answer-writing feedback is part of the preparation so students know exactly where marks are being lost. When does the batch start? The Oct/Nov 2026 A Level Business batch starts June 1, 2026. Oct/Nov 2026 is not far away. The students who improve fastest are not the ones who memorise the most. They are the ones who learn how to answer each question properly. Join SJ Academy’s A Level Business batch and start building exam-ready answers from day one. Secure Your Seat Questions? Have you ever wondered why the periodic table is arranged in such a specific way, almost like a chemical game of Tetris? The story begins with a Russian chemist named Dmitri Mendeleev, who had a brilliant idea during a long train journey in 1869. He decided to organize all the known elements as if he were playing a card game, grouping them by their similar properties. What made him truly special was his confidence in the patterns he saw—so much that he left gaps in his table for elements that hadn’t even been discovered yet! When these “missing” elements were later found with properties exactly as he predicted (like gallium and germanium), scientists realized he had unlocked a fundamental secret of nature. Is the Periodic Table Finished? You might think a science chart from the 1800s would be set in stone, but the periodic table is actually still evolving! Today, an international group of scientists called IUPAC (pronounced “eye-you-pack”) acts as the “referees” for the table. They make important decisions about new elements—like the four super-heavy elements added in 2016 with names honoring places and scientists (tennessine for Tennessee, for example!). They even update atomic weights occasionally as we get better at measuring them. Think of the periodic table less like a finished painting and more like a living document that grows as our understanding of the universe expands. What Can You Discover With This Table? Every colored square on this interactive table is a doorway to understanding our world at its most basic level. You can explore trends that explain why sodium explodes in water while calcium doesn’t, or why gold never tarnishes but iron rusts. As you click through the elements, you’re following in the footsteps of generations of scientists who’ve used these same patterns to create everything from life-saving medicines to the smartphone in your pocket. The next time you look at this table, remember: you’re not just seeing chemistry homework—you’re looking at the organized building blocks of everything around you, from the air you breathe to the stars in the sky. Students build strong concepts, practise examiner-style questions and gradually progress towards mock examinations and final revision. August September October November December January February March April May August — Foundations of Pakistan Studies History — Paper 1 Religious Thinkers Shah Waliullah Syed Ahmad Barelvi Haji Shariatullah Faraizi Movement Decline of the Mughal Empire Internal and external causes British expansion East India Company War of Independence 1857 Causes, course, failure and consequences Geography — Paper 2 The Land of Pakistan Location Provinces and administrative areas Mountains, plateaus and deserts Rivers and drainage Climate Monsoon and rainfall Natural hazards Focus Strong conceptual understanding, historical timelines, map skills and topical past papers. September — Sir Syed, Early Pakistan Movement & Natural Resources History — Paper 1 Sir Syed Ahmad Khan Educational reforms Political contribution Two-Nation Theory Aligarh Movement Hindi-Urdu Controversy Urdu and Regional Languages Partition of Bengal Simla Deputation Muslim League Morley-Minto Reforms Geography — Paper 2 Natural Resources Water resources Forests Minerals Fisheries Sustainability Focus Source-based questions, map interpretation and exam technique. October — Pakistan Movement Part 2 & Power Resources History — Paper 1 Lucknow Pact Rowlatt Act Jallianwala Bagh Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms Non-Cooperation Movement Delhi Proposals Khilafat Movement Geography — Paper 2 Power Resources Coal Oil Natural Gas Hydel Power Solar Energy Wind Energy Renewable vs Non-renewable Energy Focus Long-answer writing, past paper practice and examiner command words. November — Pakistan Movement 1927-47 & Agriculture History — Paper 1 Simon Commission Nehru Report Jinnah's 14 Points Allahabad Address Round Table Conferences Government of India Act 1935 Congress Rule Lahore Resolution Cripps Mission Gandhi-Jinnah Talks Cabinet Mission Elections of 1945-46 Direct Action Day Partition and Independence Geography — Paper 2 Agricultural Development Farming systems Major crops Livestock Irrigation Waterlogging and salinity Agricultural reforms Assessment November Monthly Test, Paper 1, Paper 2, detailed feedback and performance review. December — Great Leaders, Independence Problems & Industry History — Paper 1 Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah Allama Muhammad Iqbal Chaudhry Rahmat Ali Refugee crisis Canal Water Dispute Kashmir Issue Division of Assets National Language Issue Role of Quaid-e-Azam Geography — Paper 2 Industrial Development Manufacturing industries Cottage industries Export Processing Zones Tourism Industrial growth Assessment December Pre-Mock Examination. Winter Break: 25th December - 3rd January. January — Political Developments, Trade & Transport History — Paper 1 Liaquat Ali Khan Ayub Khan Yahya Khan Objectives Resolution Constitutions of 1956, 1962 and 1973 Creation of Bangladesh Bhutto Zia-ul-Haq Geography — Paper 2 Trade Imports Exports Balance of Trade GDP and GNP Trading Partners Transport Telecommunications Focus Essay writing, examiner reports and past papers. February — Modern Pakistan, Foreign Relations & Population History — Paper 1 Benazir Bhutto Nawaz Sharif General Musharraf Pakistan's Foreign Relations India China Afghanistan USA UK Iran Russia Bangladesh United Nations Pakistan's Nuclear Programme Geography — Paper 2 Population and Employment Population growth Migration Urbanisation Employment Human resources Development issues Milestone Complete Cambridge syllabus finished, topical past papers completed and students ready for yearly papers. March — First Mock Examination Mock & Revision Complete Paper 1 Complete Paper 2 Detailed feedback Weak-topic revision Timed past paper practice April — Final Mock Examination Final Mock & Exam Technique Full-length timed papers Source-based question practice Map and diagram revision Essay-writing improvement Examiner reports High-frequency questions May — Crash Revision Programme Final Revision Workshops Complete syllabus revision Most frequently tested questions Source-based question practice Map-work revision Case studies Model answers Examiner tips Time-management techniques Final revision workshops Live Q&A sessions Teacher Sir Kaashan Experienced Pakistan Studies and Islamiat teacher with a clear, conceptual and examiner-focused approach. We are committed to protecting the privacy and personal information of our students, parents, and website visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or interact with our digital platforms. 1 Information We Collect We collect information that you voluntarily provide to us, as well as data gathered automatically when you interact with our site. Personal Information: When you inquire about admissions, register for O Level, IGCSE, or A Level courses, or participate in our referral program, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, academic background, and payment-related information. Automated Data & Analytics: We automatically collect standard usage data when you access our site, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, pages viewed, and session duration. 2 How We Collect Your Data We gather information through the following channels: Direct Submissions: When you fill out contact forms, enrollment applications, or lead capture forms on our website. Interactive Tools: Through your interactions with our automated chat support features. Tracking Technologies: Via custom referral links, UTM parameters, and cookies used to track digital campaign performance. 3 How We Use Your Information The information we collect is strictly used to operate and improve SJ Academy. Specific uses include: Processing student admissions, updating cohort matrices, and managing academic schedules. Operating and accurately calculating rewards for our multi-tier student referral program. Delivering targeted educational content, promotional updates, and early-enrollment fee incentives. Analyzing website traffic and monitoring digital discoverability to improve our online presence. 4 Third-Party Service Providers We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to outside parties. We only share necessary data with trusted third-party service providers that facilitate our operations, subject to strict confidentiality agreements. These include: Data Management & Automation: Cloud-based spreadsheets and database workspaces used to manage our sales pipeline and student records. Marketing & Communication: Digital advertising platforms and automated messaging systems utilized to communicate with prospective students and parents. Analytics Tools: Search and web analytics services that help us monitor our site's performance. 5 Cookies and Tracking Technologies Our website utilizes cookies to enhance the user experience, maintain the functionality of our referral tracking, and gather analytics. You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, but this may affect how certain parts of the website function. 6 Data Security We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to secure your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. 7 Your Data Protection Rights You have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you. You may also request that we correct any inaccurate information, update incomplete data, or completely delete your personal information from our digital records. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below. 8 Contact Us If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: SJ Academy 📧 Email: [email protected] 📞 Phone: +923362144454 📍 Location: Karachi, Pakistan Helping Students in Karachi Achieve Their A* Dreams 🚀 Every student deserves the right guidance. Read More See all reviews on Google Frequently Asked Questions How long does the practical session last? Our practical session continues until the exam. However, students are prepared completely by mid-September so that all core practical skills are covered well before the exam period. Students are then called back before their exam for final revision, exam technique practice, and expected practical practice if reliable information is available. When is the best time to join? The best time to join is when the session starts. This gives students more time to perform each practical in detail, understand the method properly, correct their mistakes, and build confidence gradually. Can I join just before the exam? Yes, students can join close to the exam through practical workshops. However, joining earlier is strongly recommended because students get more hands-on practice, more teacher feedback, and more time to improve. What do I need to bring for the classes? Students should bring basic stationery, a calculator, and a 30 cm ruler. For Chemistry and Biology practicals, students are recommended to keep a lab coat. SJ Academy will provide the practical manual. Calculating your O Level and A Level equivalence for Pakistani universities can seem complicated, but the Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC) uses a strict mathematical formula. For O Level (SSC Equivalence) , the IBCC requires exactly 8 subjects. This includes five compulsory subjects (English, Mathematics, Urdu, Islamiyat, and Pakistan Studies) alongside three electives (such as Physics, Chemistry, and Biology for the Science group). Your grades from these top 8 subjects are converted into numerical marks out of a total denominator of 800 marks . For A Level (HSSC Equivalence) , the formula requires your 8 O Level subjects plus exactly 3 A Level subjects. The grades from these 11 subjects are combined and calculated out of a total denominator of 1100 marks . If you took more than 8 O Levels or 3 A Levels, the IBCC will automatically drop your lowest grades and only count your highest scoring subjects to maximize your equivalence percentage. What is the latest IBCC Grade Conversion Formula? To calculate your exact marks, the IBCC assigns a specific numerical value to every Cambridge (CAIE) or Edexcel letter grade. Below is the official grade conversion table used by the IBCC for the 2026 academic year: Cambridge Grade IBCC Numerical Value A* (A-Star) 90 Marks A 85 Marks B 75 Marks C 65 Marks D 55 Marks E 45 Marks U (Ungraded) 0 Marks *Note: The IBCC does not award 100 marks for an A*. The maximum possible equivalence a Cambridge student can achieve in Pakistan is 90% (unless applying under the Aga Khan Board or specific local boards). Can I get an IBCC Equivalence without Urdu, Islamiyat, and Pak Studies? Yes, but only under highly specific conditions. This is one of the most common issues students face during the university admission process. Local Pakistani students must pass all three compulsory subjects (Urdu, Islamiyat, and Pakistan Studies) to receive an O Level (SSC) equivalence. If you fail or drop these subjects, the IBCC will not issue your certificate, and you will be disqualified from local university admissions (like NED, NUST, or MDCAT). However, Overseas Pakistanis and Foreign Nationals are eligible for an exemption. If you studied outside of Pakistan for a continuous period of time (usually the entirety of your O Level / Middle School years), you can apply for an "Exemption Certificate" from the IBCC. In this case, your equivalence will be calculated out of a lower denominator, substituting the compulsory Pakistani subjects with your other electives. You can download A Level Business (9609) past papers directly from our past papers page . We have question papers, mark schemes, and inserts from 2019 to 2025 for both May/June and October/November sessions. Use the Subject filter to select Business and start downloading instantly. Do you have A Level Maths past papers available? Yes. We have a complete collection of Maths A Level past papers for CIE (9709). This includes Pure Mathematics (Papers 1, 3, 4, 5) and Statistics (Paper 6). All A Level Maths past papers are available with mark schemes so you can check your answers after practicing. Can I download A Level Physics past papers from here? Absolutely. Our A Level Physics (9702) past papers collection covers all papers including Paper 1 (Multiple Choice), Paper 2 (AS Structured), Paper 3 (Advanced Practical), Paper 4 (A2 Structured), and Paper 5 (Planning, Analysis and Evaluation). We also have Confidential Instructions for practical papers. Are A Level Chemistry past papers included? Yes. We offer A Level Chemistry (9701) past papers covering all five papers. You can download question papers, mark schemes, inserts, and Confidential Instructions. Filter by year, session, and paper type to find exactly what you need for your exam preparation. Do you have A Level Biology past papers? Yes. Our A Level Biology (9700) past papers include question papers and mark schemes for Papers 1 through 5. We also provide Confidential Instructions for the practical paper. All papers are available from 2019 to 2024 for both exam sessions. Are A Level Economics past papers available for download? Yes. We have A Level Economics (9708) past papers including Multiple Choice (Paper 1), Data Response (Paper 2), Essay (Paper 3), and the Supplementary (Paper 4). Mark schemes are included so you can evaluate your performance after each practice session. Will you add A Level Urdu past papers? We are working on adding A Level Urdu past papers to our collection. We plan to cover CIE Urdu (9686) with all available papers and mark schemes. Check back soon or follow SJ Academy for updates on when Urdu papers become available. Do you offer A Level Psychology past papers? A Level Psychology past papers are coming soon. We are expanding our library to include CIE Psychology (9990) with all paper types. Stay tuned for updates from SJ Academy. Will you add A Level Law past papers? We plan to add A Level Law (9084) past papers in the future. This will include all paper types and mark schemes. Follow SJ Academy for announcements on new subject additions. Are A Level Computer Science past papers available? A Level Computer Science (9618) past papers are on our roadmap. We aim to provide question papers and mark schemes for all papers. We will update this page as soon as they are available for download. How often are new past papers added? We update our A Level past papers collection after each exam session. New May/June papers are typically added by August, and new October/November papers by January. All subjects including Business, Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Economics are updated together. Are these past papers free to download? Yes. Zone Timetables We cross-check all your exam dates against the Administrative Zone 4 timetable to prevent any subject clashes. 3. You simply transfer your exact Cambridge exam fees plus our service fee to us, and we handle the final British Council payment on your behalf. Complete Peace of Mind Every year, private candidates in Pakistan attempt to register themselves to save a minor fee, only to experience extreme anxiety navigating the British Council portal. We take the entire burden off your shoulders. Seamless AS Carry-Forward We meticulously map your Previous Center Number and UCI (Unique Candidate Identifier) so your AS grades transfer perfectly to your final A Level result. Precise Syllabus Selection With dozens of confusing syllabus options (Variants A, B, C, D), we select the exact variant you need for your specific university track. Guaranteed Timelines We navigate the British Council deadlines for you, ensuring you never miss a cutoff or pay unnecessary late fee penalties. Flawless Documentation We handle the Smart NIC, B-Form, and passport photo requirements perfectly so exam day identity verification is entirely stress-free. Need help preparing for the exams too? Studying privately doesn't mean you have to do it alone. SJ Academy is the premier destination for private candidates in Karachi. We offer specialized batches, elite IBA/LUMS faculty, rigorous Mock Exams, and dedicated Science Lab Practicals. Explore our Private Candidate Batches Frequently Asked Questions Can I do A Levels privately in Pakistan? Yes! Thousands of students in Pakistan appear as private candidates every year for both O Levels and A Levels through the British Council. Universities globally (including IBA, LUMS, and AKU) accept private candidate grades equally to regular school candidates. What are the British Council private candidate fees for 2026? The exact fee fluctuates based on the GBP to PKR exchange rate. Typically, an O Level subject costs between Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 35,000, while an A Level subject costs between Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 45,000. SJ Academy generates your exact, updated fee voucher during our registration process. How do I do Science Lab Practicals as a private candidate? This is the biggest challenge for private candidates. You must find an academy that allows you to perform physical labs. SJ Academy is one of the few institutes in Karachi offering dedicated lab practicals for A Level private candidates. Once you register through us, you can inquire about our Lab batches. What documents do I need to register privately? You will need a valid Smart NIC or Passport, recent passport-sized photographs, and your previous CAIE result statements (especially if you are carrying forward AS grades to A2 with your UCI number). We will guide you through organizing all of these. Helping Students in Karachi Achieve Their A* Dreams 🚀 Every student deserves the right guidance. We manage your entire CAIE exam registration securely. Register Hassle-Free Frequently Asked Questions Are there any hidden charges besides the tuition fee? No. SJ Academy believes in transparent pricing. Apart from the Rs. 3,500 one-time registration fee for new students, you only pay the monthly tuition fee for your selected subjects, or the one-time lab fee if applicable. How does the lab practical fee work? The A Level lab practical fee is a one-time payment of Rs. 25,500 per subject. This covers the entire practical preparation course for the exam session, without any recurring monthly costs for labs. What is the difference between Regular and Oct/Nov batches? Regular batches run throughout the academic year at standard pacing. The Oct/Nov batches are accelerated, intensive programs designed specifically to prepare students for the Oct/Nov series in a shorter timeframe, hence the different fee structure. Does the monthly fee include the official British Council CAIE exam fee? No, our monthly tuition covers the coaching, assessments, and study resources provided at SJ Academy. The final CAIE exam registration fee is paid separately to the British Council. Are study materials and past papers included in the tuition fee? Yes. We provide all essential topical worksheets, past papers, and proprietary revision notes as part of your regular tuition. There are no surprise costs for basic academy study materials. Do you offer any scholarships or financial aid? Yes, we believe every bright student deserves top-tier education. We offer merit-based scholarships and need-based financial aid for deserving students. Please reach out to our administration office to discuss eligibility. Good? Great. Because I have good news for you. There isn’t just one way, but there are multiple ways to secure an A* in your O-level mathematics exams. Having done O/A levels myself and teaching Mathematics for the past 10 years, I have concluded that first, you need to understand what kind of a student you are . And with experience, I’ve come to understand that you can fall under these categories: 1. You’re exceptional at Math. (Naturally Gifted) 2. You’re very good. (Only tricky questions bother you) 3. You can excel, but require loads of practice. 4. You’re just not interested in the subject. Now the main thing that you all should know is that nothing beats hard work ( I’ve met a few who managed to get an A* without much hard work, but it’s rare ). So before I get into the details, first, you need to figure out which of the 4 kinds mentioned above you are! Assuming you know your type, let’s now go into the details. Perfect Your Algebra The most important way to excel in Math (and some of you won’t like this much) is to get really good at Algebra. Why Algebra? Because I cannot think of a topic that can be understood well without having a firm grip over Algebra. If you can think of one, do let me know. As a teacher, I start with basic Algebra and keep on revisiting it throughout the year . Think for a moment about what topics in Math trouble you the most. And think about this situation: Your teacher covered a topic, and you understood what they explained really well! However, as soon as a tricky question comes up, you find yourself in no man’s land! You start blaming Math as the main problem behind all your life’s worries, but you have to understand that you did not get stuck at anything in particular… what happened was that you were not able to perform the required Algebra correctly to get the solution and that’s it. I can keep on elaborating on the importance of Algebra, but let me just sum up the 1st step towards achieving excellence in Math: Work on your Algebra and perfect it before moving on to anything else. Every year it so happens that (and my ex-students can back me up on this) I explain a topic, and everyone agrees that they have understood everything. But as soon as I give a slightly different question related to the same topic, they start losing their minds about how they have no idea what to do. And every single time I perform some basic Algebra on the board (or my graphing tablet) and they all go like, “ Ohhhhhhhhh. ” So focus on improving your Algebra, and everything else will become easy. Practice, Practice & Practice So what’s the next step once you have excelled in Algebra? Make sure that after your teacher explains a particular topic, you put in the right amount of work and figure out all the possible questions that can come up. You can do that by using past papers, books, or any other resource that you have. Instead of making excuses about how you were really busy putting up a story on Insta or maintaining a streak on Snapchat, work on what’s important and what’s going to make your parents happy. However, there is one thing that will get you far: Past papers . If your exams are in May, you should start doing yearlies from March. How many years do you need to cover? My experience says 10 years of Past papers or more. It gives you the right amount of knowledge of what type of questions come up in the exams, and you are not caught off-guard if something different comes up. You should be timing your papers from April onwards, and I would suggest that you try completing P1 in 1 hour and P2 in 1 hour 30 mins even though the exam time is 2 hours and 2 hours 30 mins, respectively. You will have trouble in the beginning, but eventually, you will be able to wind up the papers in the times I have recommended. Why do I recommend doing them in half the time? Well, it helps to improve your thinking abilities, and when you sit for your CAIE you will be calm even if a couple of questions do come up that are tricky or difficult to understand. I did this practice as a student and have been doing this with my students since I started teaching, and all of them agree that it really helped them. In conclusion, I’d say that the earlier you start preparing for the exam , the better it is! This was just some advice from me, and I’d be happy to cover more ways to help you secure A*s in your O and A levels later on! I teach at SJ Academy , so if you need any help or advice, you can always drop by and have a chat with me! Or you can call me at 0336-1805842 as well! When the exams are near, it’s normal to panic every time you realize you haven’t covered your whole syllabus and need to revise a lot to be fully prepared. However, poor revision habits can lead to burnout, and you can even end up wasting your time if you’re not sure what you’re doing. Hence, it’s essential to understand how to revise for exams to be well-prepared and confident while walking into the exam hall. So here are the top tips to help you revise for your exams: 1. Start as early as possible Starting early with your preparations sounds like a no-brainer because the sooner you start your revision, the more time you have to be more organized and structured in covering your syllabus. In fact, you’re far less likely to encounter undue stress because you won’t have the pressure of cramming the entire syllabus into a last-minute study marathon. Starting early also gives you room to be organized , and you can dedicate a few hours each day and not stretch the sessions to a point where you exhaust yourself and face burnout. You can also determine the best time of the day when you’re fresh and your brain functions the best . Studying at your ideal time will help you concentrate and stay true to your revision! 2. Make sure you know what you have to revise Of course, one already knows what they’re revising, but sometimes, you can go through a revision process that tries to cover everything from the important to the not-so-important part of your syllabus. Instead, if you know your strengths and weaknesses in any given subject, you’ll be able to figure out what needs more focus . Structuring your revisions according to what needs more focus and what needs less revision time will help you cover the syllabus with far more efficiency . 3. Plan your breaks While top students may make you think that revision means spending every waking hour studying for the upcoming exam, that’s not true, and that’s also not healthy. Contrary to popular belief, taking breaks is essential and rejuvenates you for further study marathons. Hence, always plan your breaks and do not take the fact that your brain needs rest lightly. Your brain (and body as well) can get exhausted from all the studying, and giving it proper rest can be key to keeping your brain fresh , so don’t only plan your breaks, but get some light exercise in the middle as well to give your body the boost it needs. 4. Teach your friends Do you know how teachers are so great at what they teach? They’ve repeated what they know more times than they can count, which is why they seem to know way more than others. But how can that help you in your exam revisions? Simple; teach what you know to others , and you probably won’t have to keep revising it all the time. Gather a bunch of friends who are also revising for their exams and teach them the subject you’re currently trying to learn. You can take turns presenting different topics to each other, and once you’re done, you’ll find that you’ll retain all the information far better than if you were learning on your own. 5. Remove all distractions One of the biggest enemies of proper revision sessions is distractions that can come in many forms, like your mobile phone , television , PS5 , or whatever keeps your focus away from studying. While studying, a simple message from a friend can distract you, and then you have to make a lot of effort to get your focus back on studying. So if you know that you can easily get distracted by cat videos on your phone, you need to put it on silent and keep it away before starting your revision session. A cluttered space distracts , so clean your table thoroughly and keep only necessary things. This will help you focus on your exam and not get distracted. These are not the holy grail on these are not the only tips to help you prepare for your exams, they can help you prepare with flair and get far better results! People who often go to libraries for information now surf the web to find the answers to their questions. And when it comes to web surfing or learning online, YouTube is no longer just an option but one of the best platforms to advance your learning. On YouTube, you’ll find hundreds to thousands of videos that provide interactive content that makes learning fun, easy, and convenient. Why Is Learning From YouTube Channels A Good Idea? Okay, you go to school to learn stuff, so why use YouTube, right? Well, there are plenty of reasons why learning from YouTube is so great, but here are the top 2 ones: On the video-sharing platform, you’ll find hundreds to thousands of 15 to 20 mins clips that provide you tons of information in as little time. Not only do those channels make it less time-consuming, but they also make it fun and interesting. They are highly engaging and can keep you hooked on the things you want to learn. This is dramatically different from if you were to do a group study, where you could easily get distracted by conversations with your friends. Many YouTubers organize all their lessons in playlists , and you can follow a complete structure in case you want to learn properly without trying to find the appropriate video for every subject you’re trying to learn. So without diving deeper into other reasons, here are the top 5 YouTube channels for students you need to bookmark right away and binge-watch every day! 1. CrashCourse The number 1 channel on our list is CrashCourse , one of the most interactive YouTube channels for students or anyone willing to learn more. Launched in May 2006, the channel focuses on teaching a wide range of subjects like World History, Biology, Psychology , and practical life lessons like getting into college, etc. What kind of videos you’ll find on CrashCourse? How to Graduate: How To College | Crash Course How Your Biology Affects Your Health: Crash Course Geographies of the Future Martin Luther King, Jr: Black American History Intro to Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution Watch here: CrashCourse uses a unique combination of historical footage, animations and humour to keep its viewers informed and entertained simultaneously. The channel has 13.9 million subscribers and over 1.5 billion views, and you can be an excellent addition to their subscriber list if you choose to! 2. Vsauce Ever wondered what Deja Vu is? Vsauce is the channel where you’ll find the answer to such mysterious questions. Vsauce was launched on YouTube in 2010, and since then, it has been providing answers to its viewers about rhetorical questions such as “Is the Earth really flat?” and “Who owns the Moon?” etc. Vsauce is perhaps the most interesting channel on this list, considering the type of videos the channel has and the questions they answer; they really make you think and scratch your head before making you all the wiser! What kind of videos you’ll find on Vsauce? Why Are Bad Words Bad? What is the Resolution of the Eye? Why Are We Morbidly Curious? What is the Earth Worth? Did the Past Really Happen? Watch here: Already scratching your head? So are the other 18.1 million subscribers , but they’ve probably gotten their answers by now. If you’re curious about “What if the moon was a discoball?“, subscribe to this channel and start watching! 3. Veritasium Veritasium is a YouTube channel about science, education, and anything interesting that you might want to learn. If you’re looking for in-depth answers through experiments, interviews, and cool demos, then this channel will quench your thirst. What kind of videos you’ll find on Veritasium? The 4 things it takes to be an expert How Horses Save Humans From Snakebites The Simplest Math Problem No One Can Solve The Discovery That Transformed Pi How One Supernova Measured The Universe Watch here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iSNsgj1OCLA Veritasium also taught me about the person who killed millions of people to save billions of people. But why would someone kill to save humanity? Well, I got my answer, and you can too, along with 12.9 million subscribers . 4. Big Think Big Think helps you get smarter, faster! How? You’ll get to learn from stimulating content from some of the most known experts in the world, like James Webb, Neil deGrasse Tyson , and Bill Nye , etc. There’s an incredible array of videos you can binge-watch because every video will help you stimulate your curiosity and leave you wiser than before. What kind of videos you’ll find on Big Think? A Guide to Surviving Humanity’s Tipping Point Is Reality Real? These Neuroscientists don’t think so… What to do if our inner voice is cruel? How to Live an Intellectual life? How Math Predicts Life on Earth & the Universe Watch here: Big Think was launched in 2006, and since then, the channel has 4.29 million subscribers and a million views. This channel is for you if you want to know what the world’s greatest minds think about. 5. SmarterEveryDay SmarterEveryDay , launched in April 2006, teaches viewers about how science is used in the world around us. The best part of this channel is that it’s not theoretical but rather practical, and you’ll find that all the videos are super fun and not boring at all. What kind of videos you’ll find on SmarterEveryDay? How Engines Work Turning Gravity into Light Underwater Explosions in Slowmotion Helicopter Physics Series The Physics of Slingshots Watch here: But that’s not all. There’s so many more practical things to learn from this channel that you’ll be hooked once you start binge-watching the videos! SmarterEveryDay has 10.6 million subscribers and over half a billion views, and you can add to that tally if you also plan on learning more than just your textbooks! Final Thoughts These are SJ Academy’s top picks for the best YouTube channels every student must Subscribe to and bookmark so you can keep revisiting them and learning repeatedly. If you think we should add more channels to this list, please feel free to leave a comment below!
